name: Toy Car Race Track
summary:
Welcome to the biggest toy room you have ever seen. Grab a piece of classic orange track, snap it to the next one, and build the race track of your dreams right on the floor.

BUILD
- Press Y to open the round build wheel and point at any piece
- 24 track pieces snap together: straights, turns, S-curves, hills, bumps, dips, climbing turns, banked and sideways track, wall rides and loop-the-loops
- Supports appear under raised track automatically
- Choose orange, blue, green or striped track, and add finish
